newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share prices seen weak in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share prices seen weak in slow trading.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are expected to remain weak in slow trading on Thursday, with falls in Telkom and Indosat in New York overnight seen dampening sentiment, brokers said.
"Overnight falls of Indosat and Telkom in New York overnight are likely to further dampen sentiment after recent falls in the Jakarta index," one broker said.
Brokers said the market's focus was likely to include Indofood on reports that cigarette tycoon Putra Sampoerna had bought a 5.63-percent stake in the noodle maker.
The Dow Jones fall overnight was also seen dampening market sentiment, brokers said.
Bakrie was also likely to be among the active stocks following news of a plan to increase its authorised capital.
The Jakarta composite index ended 5.33 points lower at 682.61 points on Wednesday.
